title: NIC Tuning Reliability & Recovery Fixes
headline: NIC Tuning now reflects the capabilities of the selected adapter, while ownership recovery, DNS reverts, device signatures, and premium expiry cleanup fail safely.
changes: Made NIC Tuning capability-aware: unsupported Wi-Fi and adapter-specific settings are shown as unavailable instead of exposing unusable controls
Added fail-safe NIC apply and reset handling with native readback verification, driver-lock reporting, and explicit unsupported-driver messages
Reconstructed ownership records for confirmed active tweaks after local AppData loss without guessing unknown baselines
Stopped missing or corrupt DNS backups from reporting false-success reverts and repaired missing signatures for already-bound devices
Removed unreachable duplicate premium-revert execution logic so the Electron ownership pipeline remains the single authoritative expiry path
